notes.title: 《Inkbrush： The Demon Wars》 EAV1.3.8 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]New Features[/h2][list][*][p][b]\[Rest Phase] after battles[/b]:
Collect resources directly on the battlefield, with a visible operation range. Added new sound effects and “fly-to-inventory” animations for collection and loot.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45591895/8a8e5a9021e100b3a891ec13b5cc389ad53bd211.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Item System Expansion[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Added [b]consumable one-time items[/b] that are automatically destroyed after battle (e.g., Water Bomb creates Wet status at your feet).[/p][/*][*][p]Added new consumables that can [b]cleanse Wet / Poisoned / Blinded[/b] states.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a [b]“Pickpocket” one-time item[/b] that can randomly steal food from enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy food is now displayed during battle, making it easier to decide whether to steal or anticipate enemy healing.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Eating Rules[/b]: Characters can now continue moving after eating. (AI follows the same rule.)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Terrain & Resources[/b]:
Four new base map sizes (18×8, 12×12, 15×10, 10×15).
Random mountain/water tiles, tree generation (including Toxic Trees), mining nodes, animals, wheat, and other special resources.
Auto-generated decorations.
UI now shows current terrain, available resources, and enemy types.[/p][/*][*][p][b]\[Bounty System][/b]:
Unlocks starting from Stage 4, with three difficulty levels (Easy / Normal / Hard).
Enemy levels and coin rewards scale with difficulty.
Rewards from bounty battles [b]do not[/b] appear in shops.
Victory condition is unified to [b]“Defeat all enemies.”[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45591895/6c9793bc137bc16c8ee449fe8ea046403e6fcd0c.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p][b]Progression & Growth[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Removed “+Qi on every level up.” Qi can now only be obtained via [b]gear crafting[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Gain [b]1 skill point every 2 levels[/b], with a new upgrade prompt and skill animation.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted EXP formula: reduced EXP gain when defeating lower-level enemies.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Rest Phase: refined UI and operation prompts, and removed unrelated battle prompts for clarity.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved collection/loot animations when flying into the inventory.[/p][/*][*][p]Character UI: refined right-click skill prompts to prevent lingering tooltips.[/p][/*][*][p]Bounty stages: standardized enemy initial behavior for consistency.[/p][/*][*][p]Overhead defense indicator now displays correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]One-time items now display clear [b]consumable markers[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Forging interface: even for unavailable items, hovering now shows detailed information.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Trees across all maps are now prefabs, fixing initialization errors in some stages.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed spawn errors caused by blocked initial positions (increased stability).[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted edge cases in auto-generated maps to reduce units spawning on mountain tops.[/p][/*][*][p]Cleansing skill range indicators are being unified; currently, [b]Cleanse Poison[/b] only supports Lv1.[/p][/*][*][p]Bounty-related fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Random resource duplication.[/p][/*][*][p]Incorrect enemy facing direction at spawn.[/p][/*][*][p]Resource-fly animations occasionally shifting the camera view.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Terrain fixes: water tile corner auto-completion issues; camera not centered on auto-generated maps.[/p][/*][*][p]Summons: now properly handled in Camp Mode (were not displayed or able to collect).[/p][/*][*][p]Rest Phase idle character coloring fixed: previously stayed gray after entering camp, now displays normally.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: [Rest Phase] after battles: Collect resources directly on the battlefield, with a visible operation range. Added new sound effects and “fly-to-inventory” animations for collection and loot.
Added consumable one-time items that are automatically destroyed after battle (e.g., Water Bomb creates Wet status at your feet).
Added new consumables that can cleanse Wet / Poisoned / Blinded states.
Added a “Pickpocket” one-time item that can randomly steal food from enemies.
Enemy food is now displayed during battle, making it easier to decide whether to steal or anticipate enemy healing.
Eating Rules: Characters can now continue moving after eating. (AI follows the same rule.)
Four new base map sizes (18×8, 12×12, 15×10, 10×15).
Random mountain/water tiles, tree generation (including Toxic Trees), mining nodes, animals, wheat, and other special resources.
Auto-generated decorations.
UI now shows current terrain, available resources, and enemy types.
[Bounty System]: Unlocks starting from Stage 4, with three difficulty levels (Easy / Normal / Hard).
Victory condition is unified to “Defeat all enemies.”
Removed “+Qi on every level up.” Qi can now only be obtained via gear crafting.
Gain 1 skill point every 2 levels, with a new upgrade prompt and skill animation.

tags.balance_change: Adjusted EXP formula: reduced EXP gain when defeating lower-level enemies.

tags.bug: Trees across all maps are now prefabs, fixing initialization errors in some stages.
Fixed spawn errors caused by blocked initial positions (increased stability).
Adjusted edge cases in auto-generated maps to reduce units spawning on mountain tops.
Cleansing skill range indicators are being unified; currently, Cleanse Poison only supports Lv1.
Random resource duplication.
Incorrect enemy facing direction at spawn.
Resource-fly animations occasionally shifting the camera view.
Terrain fixes: water tile corner auto-completion issues; camera not centered on auto-generated maps.
Summons: now properly handled in Camp Mode (were not displayed or able to collect).
Rest Phase idle character coloring fixed: previously stayed gray after entering camp, now displays normally.

notes.title: 《Inkbrush： The Demon Wars》EAV1.3.7 7.31 Patch Notes
notes.content: [h3]🔧 [b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an interaction bug where certain materials caused sound effects to loop indefinitely after being collected.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a level-up logic bug that could cause save data to retain level-up progress even after a failed battle, and corrected display errors in HP values.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the "Close Call" skill where revived units incorrectly prompted “no tile available” despite a valid tile being present.[/p][/*][/list][p]🎨 [b]UI Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]The level-up window now auto-closes after upgrading.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the position of the guiding arrow in the upgrade interface.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where an English text label appeared blank.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45591895/47fdc265a84bed1170f0349c346fdca8565d9208.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p]🧹 [b]Optimization[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted the general Qi regeneration rate from 50% of attack power to 30%.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved enemy attack range display: enemy attack ranges are now highlighted to assist player positioning; players now only see tiles that are actually attackable.[/p][/*][/list][p]✨ [b]New Feature[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a new "Dynamic Difficulty" option: when enabled, enemy strength will automatically scale at the start of battle based on the strength of the player’s team.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.bug: Fixed an interaction bug where certain materials caused sound effects to loop indefinitely after being collected.
Fixed a level-up logic bug that could cause save data to retain level-up progress even after a failed battle, and corrected display errors in HP values.
Fixed an issue with the "Close Call" skill where revived units incorrectly prompted “no tile available” despite a valid tile being present.
Fixed a bug where an English text label appeared blank.

tags.balance_change: Adjusted the general Qi regeneration rate from 50% of attack power to 30%.

tags.feature: Added a new "Dynamic Difficulty" option: when enabled, enemy strength will automatically scale at the start of battle based on the strength of the player’s team.

notes.title: 《Inkbrush： The Demon Wars》EAV1.3.7 7.27 Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]🔧 [b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where players would not receive attribute points after battle if an enemy was killed by a counterattack during the enemy's turn.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved a bug in Level 4 where interacting with trees caused an error when hovering the mouse over terrain.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash caused by enemy AI behavior during boss battles.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed unintended experience gain from summoned units when casting skills.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Spirit Crane (墨灵鹤) would cause the game to freeze after leveling up, forcing players to restart the dungeon.[/p][/*][/list][p]🎨 [b]UI Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved terrain interaction indicators: overlapping terrain types now correctly display both interactable and non-interactable areas simultaneously.[/p][/*][/list][p]🧹 [b]Optimization[/b][/p][list][*][p]Streamlined log system. Log output is now disabled in packaged builds to improve performance and reduce file size.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where players would not receive attribute points after battle if an enemy was killed by a counterattack during the enemy's turn.
Resolved a bug in Level 4 where interacting with trees caused an error when hovering the mouse over terrain.
Fixed a crash caused by enemy AI behavior during boss battles.
Removed unintended experience gain from summoned units when casting skills.
Fixed an issue where the Spirit Crane (墨灵鹤) would cause the game to freeze after leveling up, forcing players to restart the dungeon.

notes.title: EAV1.3.7 Update Notes
notes.content:
[list][*][p]Bug fix: If you win a level during upgrade, the attribute points added during upgrade will be invalid[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Optimize item display, add item skills and attribute display[/p][/*][/list][p][b]➤ Windowed Mode Support[/b]
The game now supports three display modes:[/p][list][*][p]Borderless Window[/p][/*][*][p]Windowed[/p][/*][*][p]Fullscreen
Players can also manually choose their preferred resolution.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]➤ Qi Regeneration Adjustment[/b]
Default Qi regeneration has been simplified:[/p][list][*][p]Qi is now restored equal to [b]50% of the character's Qi Recovery stat[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]This reduces early learning complexity.[/p][/*][*][p]In later stages, players will unlock and freely combine passive Qi recovery skills for more strategic builds.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]➤ UI Fixes & Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed issue where the [b]result screen UI[/b] showed a ✔ even for units that hadn’t died.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved UI layering when [b]selecting save slots[/b] — background UI will now properly hide.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45591895/800c8a30f2b6a1478ef7a5b625ca45ab23d1b2fb.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p][b]➤ Grid Display Optimization[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Non-walkable tiles[/b] were incorrectly highlighted in green.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ally-occupied tiles[/b] no longer appear green when a unit is selected.[/p][/*][*][p]Display logic has been improved for better clarity.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45591895/ab24a0876e279f1b7cef2a9537a9d0afd7adf4a1.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p][b]➤ Ink Spirit Visual Updates[/b][/p][list][*][p]The [b]Ink Wolf's idle state[/b] appeared too faint; now redesigned with [b]enhanced blue outlines[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Ink Crane[/b] has also received visibility optimizations.[/p][/*][*][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45591895/5f1a46a1508c33ac2561b918bda9019519c232fd.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45591895/e02202292d43b0a7f41d723cf41f70daedbd489a.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][p][b]➤ Onboarding Streamlining[/b][/p][list][*][p]Tutorial prompts have been reduced to [b]prevent reading fatigue[/b] and improve pacing for new players.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]➤ Balancing Adjustments[/b][/p][list][*][p]Starting coins increased from [b]50 → 80[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Food healing doubled:[/p][list][*][p]Small food: [b]5 → 10[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Large food: [b]3 → 6[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list]

tags.bug: Bug fix: If you win a level during upgrade, the attribute points added during upgrade will be invalid
